description: Sri Lanka Customs  -  Rates of Exchange with effect from 14.05.2018 to 20.05.2018
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and concerns the determination of official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges. It represents a regulatory framework for customs operations, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organisational, land, commercial, or other specialized category.
